title: Evolving Contexts for Self-Improving Language Models - arXiv (abs 2510.04618)
snippet: Oct 6, 2025 ... Abstract page for arXiv paper 2510.04618: Agentic Context Engineering: Evolving Contexts for Self-Improving Language Models. ACE (Agentic Context Engineering) is a framework that treats contexts as evolving playbooks that accumulate, refine, and organize strategies through a modular process of generation, reflection, and curation. ACE prevents collapse with structured, incremental updates that preserve detailed knowledge and scale with long-context models.

snippet: Due to its support for incremental, "delta" context updates and non-LLM-based context merging and de-duplication, ACE demonstrates particular advantages in reducing the cost (in terms of the number of rollouts or the amount of dollar cost for token ingestion/generation) and latency of adaptation.
